Commercially Driven Executive | Chartered Surveyor | Data Center & Real Estate Investment Expert

A results-oriented executive manager with a strong background in international commercial property and finance markets. As a Chartered Surveyor, I bring deep expertise in real estate investment, data center acquisition, development and asset management with a proven track record of delivering high-value projects across global markets.

My core competencies include:
- Real Estate & Data Center Acquisition – Identifying and securing high-value opportunities with strategic growth potential.
- Development & Asset Management – Maximizing asset performance through innovative investment and management strategies.
- Financial Modelling & Due Diligence – Expert in underwriting, leveraging finance, and risk assessment to drive informed decision-making.
- Portfolio & Investment Management – Managing diverse asset classes, optimizing returns, and structuring complex transactions.
- Project & Site Assessment – Conducting in-depth feasibility studies and overseeing large-scale commercial developments.
- Hotel Acquisition & Development – Leading transactions and development strategies in the hospitality sector.

Passionate about delivering commercial success through strategic investments and innovative real estate solutions. Always open to new opportunities, partnerships and discussions on market trends.
